user.title: Connect to SA Power Networks
user.description: Sign in to the SAPN meter-data portal. Credentials are stored by Home Assistant and sent only to SAPN.

meters.title: Choose meters and channels
meters.description: Select the NMIs to import. SAPN commonly uses E channels for grid consumption and B channels for return to grid. Multiple patterns can be separated with commas.
